T: One craving. One very long night.
D: Two room-mates set out for late-night sliders and end up on an all-night odyssey across New Jersey.
P: Serve the sliders when Harold and Kumar finally reach the counter.
S: Jersey gravy fries with melted cheese
Crinkle-cut chips with mozzarella and hot beef gravy

Crunchy crinkle-cut fries smothered in hot beef gravy and melted mozzarella, finished with pepper and spring onion, eaten with a fork. Bake 1kg frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour for 1 minute, then whisk in 500ml beef stock and 1 tsp Worcestershire and simmer 5 minutes until thick. Pile the chips onto a tray, scatter with 150g grated mozzarella and grill 2 minutes until melted. Pour over the hot gravy and top with pepper and sliced spring onion.
Dill pickle spears in a polenta crumb, fried, with herb sour cream

Dill pickle spears in a crunchy cornmeal batter, fried hot and dusted with smoked paprika salt, with a cool buttermilk ranch. Pat 16 dill pickle spears very dry. Whisk 1 egg and 125ml buttermilk. Mix 75g plain flour, 75g fine polenta, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Dip the spears in buttermilk, then the flour mix. Fry at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and drain. Mix 100g sour cream, 60ml buttermilk, 2 tbsp mayo, chopped dill, chives and a crushed garlic clove for dipping.
M: Thin beef patties steamed over onions with cheddar and pickles

Tiny beef patties steamed on a bed of diced onion, then stacked with cheese and pickles in soft square buns. Press 600g beef mince thin across a lined tray and cut into 16 squares. Spread 2 finely diced onions in a hot pan with a splash of water, lay the patties on top, cover and steam 3 minutes. Add cheese and serve in 16 small soft buns with pickles.
W: Vanilla ice cream, malt powder and salted caramel with whipped cream

Vanilla ice cream blended with malted milk powder, cold milk and salted caramel, poured into tall glasses streaked with caramel and topped with whipped cream. Make salted caramel: melt 100g sugar until amber, whisk in 80ml cream and 20g butter, then half a tsp salt, and cool. Drizzle some inside 4 tall glasses. Blend 1L vanilla ice cream with 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 3 tbsp of the caramel until thick. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream and a drizzle more caramel.
K: Cherry vanilla syrup topped with cola over ice

Ice-cold cola with homemade sour cherry syrup and vanilla, poured over crushed ice with fresh lime and a cherry on top. Simmer 200g frozen pitted cherries with 80g sugar and 80ml water for 10 minutes, mashing them, then strain and stir in 1 tsp vanilla. Cool. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice. Add 40ml cherry syrup and a squeeze of lime to each, then top with 250ml cold cola. Stir gently and add a cherry and a lime wedge.

note.text: All we wanted was a small sack of burgers. Instead we got a cheetah, cops and a long night.

winks: Riding a cheetah in the woods
Harold the banker, Kumar the slacker
A bag of burgers as the goal

steps.text: Bake the frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Melt the butter and fry the finely chopped button mushrooms until brown, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the vegetable stock and the soy sauce and simmer 5 minutes until thick.
Pile the chips onto a tray, scatter with the grated mozzarella and grill 2 minutes until melted.
Pour over the hot gravy and top with pepper and sliced spring onion.
